owner_request: 2026-10-12 「都试试」 after the V12.10 ETH 15m losing-run diagnostics proposed four filter ideas
question: Does each candidate entry filter, added alone to frozen SPIKE V12.10 15m, raise net R per trade out of sample (20 liquid alts) in both periods, and do the filtered entries beat random entries drawn under the same VIDYA state and the same filter condition?
single_variable: One admission filter per variant on top of V12.10; signals, VIDYA gate, exits, fills (next open) and 0.2% round-trip cost unchanged; rejected signals release occupancy (serial ledger rerun).

F1_trend8d.label: 大趋势同向
F1_trend8d.rule: side * (close - SMA(close, 800)) > 0 at the signal bar

F2_vidya_fresh.label: VIDYA 新鲜
F2_vidya_fresh.rule: bars since the VIDYA trend state last flipped <= 4 at the signal bar

F3_not_chop.label: 不做震荡
F3_not_chop.rule: efficiency ratio over the prior 96 bars (|close - close[96]| / sum |delta close|) >= 0.05

F4a_near_vidya.label: 不追远
F4a_near_vidya.rule: side * (close - VIDYA trend line) / ATR14 <= 4.5 (line = lower band in up state, upper band in down state)

F4b_no_big_bar.label: 不追大K线
F4b_no_big_bar.rule: (high - low) / ATR14 <= 1.75 on the signal bar

atr: ATR14 = Wilder RMA of true range on the 15m chart, as in analyze_streaks.py of the five-year study
provenance: All five thresholds come from the in-sample terciles of exp-spike-v1210-eth15m-5y-20261012-v1/analyze_streaks.py on OKX ETH 15m (rounded where noted); they are fixed here before any filtered result is computed. ETH results are therefore in-sample and descriptive.

eth_okx.parity: V12.10 closed trades must equal that experiment's results_v1/okx_vidya_gate_trades.csv.gz

alts.source: spike_v129_alts_confirm.base5m (frozen Binance USD-M 5m series, warmup from 2022-11-01)
alts.parity: V12.10 closed trades must equal exp-spike-v1210-volumatic-vidya-gate-20261012-v1 results_v1/vidya_gate_trades.csv.gz (binance, 15m)

primary: Out of sample = pooled 20 alts. A filter IMPROVES V12.10 if pooled mean net R per trade is higher than V12.10's in both alt periods. It PASSES if in addition its trades beat the state-and-filter-matched random control with positive excess and month-block sign-flip p < 0.01 in both alt periods. ETH rows are in-sample and descriptive.
control: One deterministic random entry per trade: same symbol, side, UTC week, fold, ATR/close bin, same VIDYA state and the same filter condition true at the random bar; same exit engine and cost.
notes: Combinations of filters are not tested (multi-variable; owner approval needed).
No Pine, monitor, preset or account change.
